laws.summary: Punishment for identity theft — fraudulent or dishonest use of another person's electronic signature, password or other unique identification feature.
Punishment for cheating by personation by using a computer resource or communication device.
Cheating — deceiving a person to deliver property or consent to the retention of property.
Cheating by personation — pretending to be another person in order to deceive.
